post.excerpt: We're expanding Workers AI with new partner models from Leonardo.Ai and Deepgram. Start using state-of-the-art image generation models from Leonardo (Phoenix, Lucid Origin) and real-time TTS and STT models from Deepgram (Nova 3, Aura 1). Build full-stack, low-latency AI applications, all hosted on Cloudflare's global network.
post.title: State-of-the-art image generation Leonardo models and text-to-speech Deepgram models now available in Workers AI
